topic: Kamu mendengar kabar Dajjal akan segera muncul
title: BAGAIMANA KALAU
DAJJAL SEGERA MUNCUL?

power.rule: a forwarded rumour says the Dajjal appears this week; the hero checks the real sources instead of panicking
power.look: a FORWARDED chip and a share counter while the hoax spreads; a calm warm grade once he checks the hadith

script.text: Jam dua pagi. Ponselmu bergetar. Grup keluarga: Dajjal muncul minggu ini. Sebarkan!
Satu juta kali dibagikan. Pagi harinya, satu kota panik.
Bagaimana kalau kamu dengar Dajjal akan segera muncul?
Kamu ngga ikut panik. Kamu cek sumbernya.
Hadis sahih riwayat Muslim: Dajjal tinggal empat puluh hari. Satu hari seperti setahun. Satu seperti sebulan. Satu seperti seminggu. Itu nyata.
Tapi tanggalnya? Ngga ada satu dalil pun yang menyebutnya.
Malam itu, di TV, seorang pria tersenyum. Ikut saya. Saya bawa surga. Padahal menurut hadis, surga yang dia bawa justru neraka.
Adikmu menarik bajumu. Kak, aku takut. Kamu ajari dia sepuluh ayat pertama surah Al-Kahfi. Pelindung dari Dajjal.
Besok paginya, matahari terbit. Dan ngga terbenam lagi. Bersambung.

science.claim: In a sahih hadith narrated by Muslim, the Dajjal stays on earth forty days: one day like a year, one like a month, one like a week, and the rest like ordinary days.
science.working: Narrated by an-Nawwas ibn Sam'an. The companions asked whether one day's prayers would suffice for the day like a year; he said no, estimate its time. Parallel report in Abu Dawud 4321 (graded sahih by al-Albani).

science.claim: Whoever memorises the first ten verses of Surah al-Kahf is protected from the Dajjal.
science.working: Narrated by Abu ad-Darda'. Another narration in Muslim says the last ten verses; scholars advise learning both. The script says the first ten, which is the wording of 809a.

science.claim: What the Dajjal presents as paradise is in fact hell (fire).
science.working: The Dajjal will come with something like paradise and hell; what he calls paradise will be hell. Narrated by Abu Hurairah (Bukhari); Hudhayfah's narration in Muslim: what people see as water is fire, what they see as fire is cool sweet water.

science.claim: No text names the date of the Dajjal's appearance.
science.working: The hadith describe signs and events around the Dajjal but give no date; any message naming a day or week is not from the Quran or authentic hadith. The episode treats the forwarded date as a hoax.
science.source: Absence of any dated report in the canonical collections (Bukhari, Muslim, the Sunan); general scholarly position that the timing of the Hour's major signs is unknown

notes.respect: Prophets are never depicted. The Dajjal is never shown directly: only a smiling man on a TV, his face half in shadow. The mushaf is drawn closed or as abstract ornament, never with invented Arabic text.
notes.cast: MC (the user's main character, every episode), his little sister (sis), his mum (momHijab)

shots.note: 02:00: MC asleep in bed, the room dark
the phone on the nightstand lights up and buzzes
the family group chat: a forwarded message, DAJJAL MUNCUL MINGGU INI. SEBARKAN!!
MC sits up, face lit blue by the phone, eyes wide
phones lighting up across a grid; a share counter runs to 1.000.000
the city in the morning: sirens, smoke, every window lit by a phone
the premise over the city; MC alone on the roof
MC at his desk breathes out, calm: no panic
an open book of hadith, a finger running down the page; tag HR. MUSLIM 2937
forty day cells pop on: 40 HARI
bar 1 stretches: HARI 1 = 1 TAHUN
bar 2: HARI 2 = 1 BULAN
bar 3: HARI 3 = 1 MINGGU
MC, serious: that's real
a calendar, the forwarded date circled with a question mark
a red cross stamps the date: TIDAK ADA DALIL
the family on the sofa, TV light flickering on their faces
on the TV: a smiling man in a suit, half his face in shadow, arms open
the paradise on screen (a green garden) glitches into fire
his little sister tugs at his hoodie
sis, scared
MC beside her, a closed mushaf on his lap, teaching her
the mushaf, green and gold, soft light; tag AL-KAHFI 1-10
next morning the sun rises over the city
a clock spins through the day; the sun doesn't move
MC stares at the sun; BERSAMBUNG
